hooks.command: for py in /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.14 /usr/local/bin/python3.14 /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/python3.14; do [ -x "$py" ] && exec "$py" "$HOME/.codex/hooks/git_guard.py"; done; echo 'git_guard.py: Python 3.14 not found in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin or /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin; run provision.sh or brew install python@3.14' >&2; exit 2
